    Generic grains at missing integral weights #

    Proposition 7.6 (prop:grain) and the (E-fin) ⇔ (no-gen-grain) equivalence of Theorem 7.8 (isEFinite_iff_no_genericGrain). Whereas the manuscript constructs generic grains over Cohn's universal skew field, Lean constructs the required division ring self-containedly from Malcev–Neumann well-ordered power series on a bi-ordered finitely generated free group (DivisionRings/), producing an endofinite module N realizing the numerical torsion pair at a missing weight whose indecomposable summands include a generic grain (exists_weight_with_generic_grain_kernel).

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_division_injective_boundary (k ι : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype ι] :
    ∃ (D : Type u) (x : DivisionRing D) (x_1 : Algebra k D) (a : ι → D), Function.Injective ⇑(freeTensorBoundary k a)

    Division coefficients with an injective free tensor boundary exist in every characteristic.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_endofinite_kernel_for_weight (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (γ : ProjectiveClass R) :
    ∃ (N : ModuleCat R), IsEndofinite N ∧ SplitsOnCogeneratedModules k N ∧ perpendicularToModule N = ((projectiveClassWeight k) γ).weakTorsionClass ∧ cogeneratedByModule N = fun (X : FGModuleCat R) => ∀ {U : FGModuleCat R} (i : U ⟶ X) [CategoryTheory.Mono i], ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero U → ((projectiveClassWeight k) γ).eval U < 0

    Every integral weight admits an endofinite module realizing both halves of its numerical torsion pair and splitting extensions on the cogenerated class.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_weight_with_generic_grain_kernel (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (hn : ¬IsEFinite R) :
    ∃ (γ : ProjectiveClass R), (¬∃ (P : TwoTerm R), P.IsPresilting ∧ P.projectiveClass = γ) ∧ ∃ (N : ModuleCat R), IsEndofinite N ∧ SplitsOnCogeneratedModules k N ∧ perpendicularToModule N = ((projectiveClassWeight k) γ).weakTorsionClass ∧ (cogeneratedByModule N = fun (X : FGModuleCat R) => ∀ {U : FGModuleCat R} (i : U ⟶ X) [CategoryTheory.Mono i], ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero U → ((projectiveClassWeight k) γ).eval U < 0) ∧ ∃ (G : ModuleCat R), Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Retract G N) ∧ IsGenericGrain k G

    Some integral weight outside the presilting fan has a splitting endofinite kernel with a generic grain as a direct summand.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.isEFinite_iff_no_genericGrain (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] :
    IsEFinite R ↔ ¬∃ (N : ModuleCat R), IsGenericGrain k N

    E-finiteness is equivalent to absence of a generic grain over every field.
